g.text: TaarofBench: LLMs score 40–48% below native Persian speakers on taarof scenarios.
Frontier models do well on factual recall but show gaps in cultural knowledge and pragmatic judgment
(Khayyam, FarsEval-PKBETS, ELAB). Taarof is absent from all existing evaluation frameworks.
Persian needs new kinds of tests; the other varieties need a first test.
